releaseChecklist.action: Confirm authoritative DownloadStateData ISO export/version stamp (or approved human policy).
Check authorized mailbox for CDSS reply; never resend duplicate inquiry from agents.
Explicitly approve and activate offline exclusion policy in app/DB for listing/map/disclosure scopes.
Approve or reject Provisional License and Licensed/Pending Increase publication mappings.
Re-download DownloadStateData; confirm sha256 / accounting 24,377; investigate any delta before launch.

Confirm CDSS/Transparency source licensing and attribution terms for publication.
Human QA on search, map, disclosure links, and unpublished-elsewhere safeguards.
Separate explicit approval to open californiaDirectoryReady / publication gate.
Monitor CDSS source drift, disclosure failures, and exclusion reinstatement audits.

rollbackPlan.title: California launch rollback plan (future use only)
triggers: Authoritative source delta invalidates roster freshness claims
Widespread FacilityDetail/disclosure failures or rate-limit lockout
Incorrect publication of excluded / provisional / missing-date facilities
Human request to revert California to unpublished
steps: 1. Immediately set California directory publication back to unpublished (gate blocked).
2. Disable owner-claim eligibility for California if it was enabled.
3. Keep offline exclusion matrix and audit evidence intact; do not delete government source snapshots.
4. Revert or disable any activated exclusion wiring that is misbehaving; prefer fail-closed suppressions.
5. Announce rollback in ops notes; do not silently re-publish.
6. Re-enter STOP state until goRequiresAll criteria are re-satisfied.
nonGoals: Do not rewrite DownloadStateData / FacilityDetail government fields.
Do not deploy from agents without human approval.
Do not treat rollback as permission to invent coordinates or capacities.

beforeAnyFutureGo: Authoritative ISO export date present or explicit human override documented
Eligibility matrix applied offline with audit trail; activation approved
No unresolved provisional/pending-increase IDs left publication-eligible without mapping approval
